findings.title: Install the format plugin in audit validation CI

evidence.note: The validator loads ajv-formats but the command installs only ajv-cli.
The generated_at field uses the date-time format.

findings.rationale: The CI validation command exited before reading the instance because ajv-formats could not be resolved. Valid audit reports can fail the audit gate.
findings.proposal: Install compatible versions of ajv-cli and ajv-formats in the same CI invocation and validate a known-good audit plus one with an invalid generated_at value.

findings.title: Resolve global event ID uniqueness before implementing partitions

evidence.note: Requires monthly occurred_at partitions and uniqueness on event_id.
Client-generated event_id is the idempotency key.
The event-store implementation is still a stub.

findings.rationale: PostgreSQL 16 requires a unique constraint on a partitioned table to include every partition key column. Uniqueness on event_id alone is unavailable with the specified partition key. Adding occurred_at to the constraint would allow the same ID with a changed timestamp.
findings.proposal: Supersede ADR-0002 with a storage design that enforces global event_id uniqueness. Require a Postgres integration test that retries one ID with timestamps in different months and observes one stored event.

findings.title: Make audit-to-Linear imports safe to rerun

evidence.note: The push workflow selects the added report again on rerun.
The import loops through every finding.
Each finding issues an unconditional create.

findings.rationale: If the import stops midway, a workflow rerun creates new issues for findings already imported. A rerun after full success duplicates the entire report.
findings.proposal: Persist a stable import identity derived from milestone and finding ID, reuse existing issues on retry and test that rerunning a partially completed import creates only the missing issues.

findings.title: Measure the size:S merge rate per milestone for ADR-0011

evidence.note: The G1 decision requires two qualifying size:S milestones.
The aggregate accepts a lower date bound without milestone membership or issue size.
The retro asks the agent to reconstruct the size:S cohort.
Retro preparation calls metrics without a milestone filter.

findings.rationale: The printed unchanged percentage pools agent PRs across sizes and milestones. The retro needs PR-level membership and outcomes to verify the gate threshold.
findings.proposal: Join merged agent PRs to their milestone issues and report the size:S numerator, denominator and PR links, with an explicit incomplete result when the join or timeline data is incomplete.

findings.title: Bind published local infrastructure ports to loopback

evidence.note: Postgres publishes a host port with a default development password.
Mongo is intended for local use without authentication.
Mongo publishes a host port without a host IP.
The operating guide describes Mongo as local-only.

findings.rationale: Compose mappings without a host IP bind to all host interfaces by default. Reachability then depends on host and network configuration, leaving the local services unnecessarily exposed.
findings.proposal: Bind the published Postgres, Mongo, Metabase and n8n ports to loopback by default and document the bind behavior.

findings.title: Specify privacy controls for custom event properties before ingestion

evidence.note: Arbitrary property keys and string values pass the shared contract.
The spec documents primitive values without a property admission policy.
ES-09 forbids payloads from carrying personal data beyond ADR-0009.

findings.rationale: The schema checks property shape. It provides no way to distinguish approved tracking metadata from arbitrary visitor input. Persistence would make accidental collection difficult to remediate under the append-only design.
findings.proposal: Define an explicit property admission and redaction policy at the collector boundary before event storage and test rejected fields and permitted metadata. Keep frozen wire versions intact under ES-07.

findings.title: Scope exported workflow findings to the retro milestone

evidence.note: The retro is responsible for findings of its milestone.
Milestone issues are fetched from the selected milestone.
Workflow findings are fetched by team and source label only.

findings.rationale: Later retros receive findings from earlier milestones in the same team. The retro can reopen settled decisions or attribute old failures to the wrong milestone.
findings.proposal: Associate workflow findings with a milestone and filter the retro export accordingly. Test that a retro excludes a finding associated with a different milestone.
